terms.definition: A plant hormone that controls growth near the tips of shoots and roots, causing phototropism and gravitropism.
terms.examiner: Unequal distribution of auxin causes unequal growth.

terms.definition: Growth of a plant in response to light.
terms.examiner: In a shoot, auxin builds up on the shaded side, which grows faster, so the shoot bends towards the light.

terms.definition: Growth of a plant in response to gravity (also called geotropism).
terms.examiner: In roots, more auxin on the lower side slows growth there, so the root bends downwards.

terms.definition: Plant hormones that start seed germination.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. Used to end seed dormancy, promote flowering and make fruit bigger.

terms.definition: A plant hormone that controls cell division and ripening of fruits.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. Used to ripen fruit during distribution.

terms.definition: Contains auxins; used to make cuttings grow roots.
terms.examiner: Auxins are also used as weed killers.
